mercimek.name: Supū Lini
mercimek.description: Supū lini na faia i le fale i le auala masani, ua uma i se sosū pata.

tas-kebabi.name: Stew Povi Turuki
tas-kebabi.description: Povi, fualaʻau o taimi eseese, ma le sosu fa'apitoa ua fa'auma malie i le matou fale'aiga.

kuzu-tandir.name: Mamoe Faʻaumu Faʻaai
kuzu-tandir.description: O le tandoori mamalu a la matou faleʻaiga, fai māmā i le vevela maualalo mo se taimi umi.

pirinc-pilavi.name: Pilaf araisa
pirinc-pilavi.description: Pilaf araisa Baldo mago ma mama.

firin-sutlac.name: Pudding araisa falai
firin-sutlac.description: Pudding araisa falai i le auala masani, sauni ma le susu povi i aso uma.

kuru-fasulye.name: Stew Pipi Paʻepaʻe ma Povi
kuru-fasulye.description: Fasimea İspir, povi ʻapipiʻi, ma paste tamato faleʻaiga masani.

izgara-kofte.name: Meatballs Grill
izgara-kofte.description: Meatballs povi i le sitaili fagu ma pepa roast ma tamato.

ayran.name: Ayran Churned
ayran.description: Buttermilk masani churned ma tele foam, faia mai i yogurt i aso uma.

ezogelin-corbasi.name: Ezogelin Soup
ezogelin-corbasi.description: Soup faleʻaiga masani lea e feiloaʻi lentils mumu, bulgur, ma araisa ma minti.

tarhana-corbasi.name: Tarhana Soup
tarhana-corbasi.description: Tarhana fai i le fale, se klasika Anatolian e ulaula malu ma tamato ma minti mago.

yayla-corbasi.name: Supoa Yogurt ma Reis
yayla-corbasi.description: O se supoa malulu ma mago lalo saunia ma yogurt, reis, ma minti mago.

iskembe-corbasi.name: Supoa Tripe
iskembe-corbasi.description: O se supoa tripe povi saʻo ua tautaua ma ona tofo ma vinega solo.

dugun-corbasi.name: Supoa Fiafia
dugun-corbasi.description: O se supoa faa-taua ua faia ma mamoe ua tipi i ni fasi ma tofoina ma le marinade lemona.

tavuk-suyu-corbasi.name: Supoa Lalaga Moa
tavuk-suyu-corbasi.description: O se supoa faamalolo ua saunia ma noodles manifinifi kuka i le tulimatua ma fasi moa tipi.

domates-corbasi.name: Supoa Tamato
domates-corbasi.description: O se tofo mauoa kuka ma tamato maua, pata, ma basil, fa'amae'a i lalo o sisi.

sebze-corbasi.name: Supō Fua Manu
sebze-corbasi.description: O se supō malamalama i fale taumafai na saunia ma fuala'au i le vaitau, suau'u olive, ma la'au fou.

beyran-corbasi.name: Supō Lamu Beyran Fa'asu'asu
beyran-corbasi.description: O se supō i le itulagi na saunia i luga o le vevela maualuga ma lamu, araisa, sina, ma pepa vevela.

kelle-paca-corbasi.name: Supō Ulu ma Va'e
kelle-paca-corbasi.description: O se supō māmā manu'i ua kuka i vae povi ma ponaivi o le ulu mo itula tele.

sehriye-corbasi.name: Supō Vermicelli
sehriye-corbasi.description: Soup i aso uma saunia ma brotini moa ma tamato, vermicelli, ma lalo.

tavuk-sis.name: Sulugooni Moa
tavuk-sis.description: Vaega moa fa'afefiloi ma taumafaina fa'apitoa, 'ai fa'atasi ma pepa ula ma tamato tao.

kasap-sucuk.name: Sucuk Fuala'au i le sua he'i
kasap-sucuk.description: Sausage povi pi'i i mea'ai, kuka i luga o koale, fa'apipi'i ma fuala'au tao ma aniana ma sumaki.

karisik-izgara.name: Grill Su'afa
karisik-izgara.description: Se ipu grill tele ma lami e aofia ai meatballs, sulugooni moa, lamb chops, ma sausage.

nohut-yemegi.name: Stew Pepepi ma Povi
nohut-yemegi.description: O se taumafataga a le fale na sauni ai ni praati fualaau ma povi tipi e tolu i luga o le vai uʻamea lafo.

patlican-musakka.name: Mousaka Fualaʻau ʻAva
patlican-musakka.description: Fualaʻau ʻava faʻapapa, povi solo, ma le mousaka kuka i le ogaumu ma sosi tamato, i le sitaili faletalimalo.

zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.name: Papaya Lanu Meamata i le Suʻauʻu Oliva
zeytinyagli-taze-fasulye.description: O se auala masani e kuka ai i le suauʻu oliva ma fualaʻau lanumeamata, tamato, ma aniani, sauni mo le 'aʻai malulu.

tavuk-sote.name: Moʻa Sautéed
tavuk-sote.description: O fasi moa e sauté i luga o le vevela maualuga ma pepa lanu eseese, mātūtū, ma tamato.

izmir-kofte.name: Papa Moa Stil Izmir
izmir-kofte.description: O se ipu autu masani o tamaʻi povi, pateta, ma pepa e tao i le sauce tamato.

etli-bezelye.name: Pi ma Povi
etli-bezelye.description: O se taumafataga i aso uma e kuka i totonu o se ipu ma povi tipi, pi, karoti, ma pateta.

patlican-oturtma.name: Oni Tao ma Fasi Povi
patlican-oturtma.description: O le tino o le ulu tausi i le ogaumu faatasi ma oni, fasi povi pipi, ma le sauce tamato lauu.

salgam-suyu.name: Su Turnip Fa'asūsū
salgam-suyu.description: Su turnip pipi masani fa'asūsū faatasi ma karoti viole ma sisi bulgur.

maden-suyu.name: Suavai Mineral
maden-suyu.description: Suavai mama ma natura mineral e taumafai i le mālūlū.

su.name: Vai Punavai Faʻanatura
su.description: Vai punavai masani e tautatolu i le malulu i totonu o le fagu tioata.

kola.name: Cola
kola.description: O se isi meainu kasa masani e tautatolu i le malulu ma le aisa.

gazoz.name: Soda Lēmōni Turuki
gazoz.description: Soda masani e iai le tofo, māfanafana, ma tautatolu i le malulu leai se mea faʻaopoopo.

turk-kahvesi.name: Kofi Turuki
turk-kahvesi.description: Kofi Turuki masani ma le paʻu, kuka i le vevela maualuga i le cezve uʻamea kopera.

demleme-cay.name: Laʻau Uō Turuki
demleme-cay.description: Laʻau Rize fou e vevela i totonu o se ipu tioata manifinifi i le taliga.

ev-yapimi-limonata.name: Līmōne Lausi Fai i le Fale
ev-yapimi-limonata.description: Leimonade fou e saunia i aso uma ma le leimona fou, mīti, ma se sila suka.

hosaf.name: Fua Fua Iaso
hosaf.description: Compote fale e kuka i aso uma ma raisins, apricots, po o plums e tusa ai ma le vaitau.

iskender-kebabi.name: Bursa İskender Kebab
iskender-kebabi.description: O le meaʻai e liua i luga o se skewer i luga o pide, tautua ma sosi tamato, pata vevela, ma yogurt.

kazandibi.name: Pudding Suāu Karamela
kazandibi.description: Se meaʻai suāu masani na karamela lelei, ma se paʻu silk.

tavuk-gogsu.name: Pudding Suāu Ottoman
tavuk-gogsu.description: O se meainuai susu mama ma filo e saunia i se fua masani, tautua fa'atasi ma sisi cinnamon.

keskul.name: Pudding Suauu 'Alamona
keskul.description: Mea'ai susu sitaili Ottoman ua mae'a ma tofo 'alamona ma sinasina talo.

irmik-helvasi.name: Halva Semolina
irmik-helvasi.description: Halva semolina, sasaa ma pata ma nati pine, tautua māfanafana ma fasi saito.

kabak-tatlisi.name: Meainu'ai Puipui ma Tahini
kabak-tatlisi.description: O le puipui, e fa'ata'amilo malu i lona sua, e tautua fa'atasi ma tahini ma walnuts.

ayva-tatlisi.name: Meainu'ai Quince
ayva-tatlisi.description: O le quince ua kuka fa'atasi ma cloves ma cinnamon e tautua fa'atasi ma kirimu faigata ma walnuts.

revani.name: Keke Salu Semolina
revani.description: O le suamalie masani i faletalimalo lea e feiloaʻi ai le keke malamalama semolina ma suacepipi manogi lemu.

ekmek-kadayifi.name: Pudding Apa ma Kirimu Ga'o
ekmek-kadayifi.description: O le pudding apa na malologa ma suacepipi caramelized e tuʻuina ma le kirimu gaʻo povi.

cevizli-baklava.name: Baklava Wanut
cevizli-baklava.description: Faigamea laupapa manifinifi, baklava faʻalelei faia i le tele o wanut ma pata masani.
